Origin and meaning

With English origins, Lincoln is usually read as “town by the pool (a surname)”.

About the name Lincoln

The surname of Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Lincoln carries the meaning “town by the pool (a surname)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
